popsockets - low-pro grip for magsafe, u.description: Meet the ultra-thin phone grip designed to disappear. At just 2.6mm, the PopSockets Low-Pro Grip delivers a secure hold that disappears into your pocket when you don't need it. The integrated kick-out stand props your phone in portrait or landscape for hands-free scrolling, filming, and watching. Built-in MagSafe magnets snap onto compatible phones, cases, and PopSockets mounts for seamless attachment and removal. The comfortable, ergonomic grip flexes with your fingers for one-handed use while texting, scrolling, or commuting. Built to last with a high-strength aluminum base and stainless steel kickstand. Compatible with iPhone 12 and newer, MagSafe and Qi2-compatible phone cases, MagSafe and Qi2 wireless chargers, and PopSockets magnetic mounts.
